primary_base: Beacon_A1 / v4.5A BLACKBOX HOME CORTEX POLISH
late_donor: ADV Elite Zero v0.20 SKY ANCHOR

mission.goal: self-learning distributed predictive AI that models world + swarm + self and navigates from timestamped past toward possible futures

architecture.JANUS: distributed heterogeneous swarm of independent compute nodes
architecture.ADV_Elite: autonomous predictive Beacon/Tachyon/M2R organ that remains useful solo and contributes to the collective when connected

m2r.role: past-to-future navigation by generating/scoring plausible future-state trajectories
m2r.dirac_belt: architectural continuity/path-memory metaphor only; not evidence of retrocausality
m2r.tachyon_guard: architecture/persona metaphor, not literal faster-than-light behavior

memory.node_without_storage: forward short-term state/episodes to a trusted storage-capable peer and track archival debt until acknowledged
memory.forgetting: old ordinary data may be compacted/deleted only after useful information is extracted and retention/provenance gates pass

witness.runtime_write: append canonical JSON objects as JSONL/NDJSON
witness.correction_policy: append correction/superseding record; never silently rewrite history
witness.truth_guard: hash verifies integrity/lineage, not measurement truth

resolved_questions.Q02: M2R=physics-informed forward World Model; authoritative time axis aligns forecast with realized future
resolved_questions.Q04: predict everything observable/modelable including JANUS itself: world + swarm + self
resolved_questions.Q05: JANUS is distributed swarm cognition; ADV_Elite is one autonomous predictive organ/node within the organism
resolved_questions.Q06: each device is an independent solo-capable compute/learning node; swarm connectivity is optional and increases shared data/experience; Habitat is optional; SHA-256 mining remains a separate truth-preserving adaptive lane
resolved_questions.Q07: A+B tiered memory; storage-less nodes offload to capable peers; low-value history may be safely forgotten only after value extraction while anomalies/unusual forensic episodes are preserved
resolved_questions.Q08: write JANUS-compatible JSON records directly; JSONL/NDJSON for append-safe runtime storage; sealed JSON chunks/manifests; per-node/session hash chain
